answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, with misbehavior slashing that bond. A Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so the cost ripples outward with every new sock puppet instead of staying flat. Honest agents keep their haven of earned reputation intact, while cheap throwaway accounts sink like basalt: heavy to build, slow to grow, and easy to spot when they all draw from one wallet.
